mappings.note: The translation starts with a title/heading ('Au maître-chantre. Psaume de David...') which corresponds to the introductory text of OSMAIN v1 but is separated as its own verse in this translation. The actual content of OSMAIN v1 (starting 'Synden taler...') begins at Translation v2.
